description: Investment partnership in which Avraham Munīr b. Saʿd declares that he has received 25000 מ״ך (medin) as an investment from Rabbi Moshe Kandiote (קנדיוטי). Moshe Ayalon stands as a guarantor for the partnership. Dating: likely early 19th-century, probably the scribal hand of Meʾīr Ben-Naʿīm. MCD.
description_he: מסמך משפטי מאוחר. אברהם מוניר בן סעד מצהיר שקיבל 25,000 מ"כ כהשקעה ממשה קנדיוטי.
